# Tom Select 2.6.2

Source: https://github.com/orchidjs/tom-select/tree/v2.6.2

The unmodified base JS bundle (including its Sifter/MicroPlugin dependencies), default CSS,
and Apache-2.0 license were downloaded from the pinned npm package through jsDelivr:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tom-select@2.6.2/

These files are served locally and included in the service worker shell. No CDN is
contacted by the running application. Upstream notices are retained in the files.
